{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sidebar plugin: stack-safe fork tree, two-track indentation, marquee title, leading/hover slots, and cascade purge.","id":"gh:1350740318","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-branch-workspace-folders","slug":"The-latest-one/dsh-branch-workspace-folders","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","productivity","sidebar","tree-view","workspace"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sidebar plugin: stack-safe fork tree, two-track indentation, marquee title, l"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"eading/hover slots, and cascade purge."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-branch-workspace-folders"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"🌐 **English** | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> DeepSeek Harness (DSH) full-featured ecosystem extension: strictly aligned with official UI/UX des"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ign contracts to deeply rearchitect the sidebar workspace and session tree. Delivers **heap-allocate"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"d non-recursive stack-safe session trees**, **`placeFork` intelligent fork clustering**, **two-track"},{"id":"p4s4","text":" indentation decoupling**, **constant-speed title marquee with fade masking**, **official leading & "},{"id":"p4s5","text":"hover slot compatibility**, **collapsed status bubbling**, **archived tri-state filtering**, and a *"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"*physical cascading purge transaction engine**."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 📸 Visual Preview"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Left: Sidebar tree grouping, placeFork clustering & L-shaped vector rails  |  Right: Multi-tier inde"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ntation, solid triangle toggles & status bubbling"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ⚡ Quick Comparison: Native DSH vs. This Plugin"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Capability / Pain Point | Official Native DSH | Other Community Plugins | **dsh-branch-workspace-f"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"olders** |
|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| **Forked Session Hierarchy** | ❌ Flat list only, scattered by r"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ecency | ⚠️ Pop out standalone SVG panel | **✅ Native in-place collapsible tree with L-shaped guide "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"rails** |
| **New Fork Positioning** | ⚠️ Appended at arbitrary list ends | ❌ Unchanged | **✅ `place"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"Fork` auto-clusters adjacent above parent session** |
| **Folded Status Bubbling** | ❌ None (blindsp"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ot for running tasks) | ❌ None | **✅ 4-state priority FSM (approval warnings bubble to root)** |
| *"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"*Physical Disk Deletion** | ❌ Soft archive only (`.zstd` logs persist) | ⚠️ Standalone trash button "},{"id":"p8s8","text":"/ no cascade | **✅ True cascading physical purge with rollback safety** |
| **Indentation Reliabilit"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"y** | ❌ Negative indentation in directory trees | ❌ Overrides directory spacing | **✅ Two-track deco"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"upled variables (`--dsh-branch` & `--dsh-ws`)** |
| **Engine Recursion Safety** | ❌ N/A | ⚠️ Direct "},{"id":"p8s11","text":"recursion (risk of stack overflow) | **✅ Heap-allocated explicit stacks (tested against 20,000 depth"},{"id":"p8s12","text":")** |
| **DSH v0.2.0-rc.2 Alignment** | ⚠️ Shipped in native | ❌ Legacy 0.1.x baselines | **✅ 100% a"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"ligned (two-tier slots, 0.03px/ms marquee, FLIP keys)** |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## 🌟 Key Features & Problems Solved"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### 1. Universal Fork Tree & Visual Hierarchy
- **Universal Grouping Coverage**: In `workspace` (gro"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"uped), `workspace-tree` (physical directory tree), or `flat` (single list) mode, all forked sessions"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" cluster under their designated root session based on durable lineage.
- **Two-Track Indentation Dec"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"oupling**: Independently allocates `--dsh-branch-indent: calc(depth * 16px)` and `--dsh-workspace-in"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"dent`, completely resolving negative indentation and layout displacement under nested directory tree"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" modes.
- **Official Slot Ecosystem Integration (Leading & Hover Slots)**: Fully supports DSH v0.2.0"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"-rc.2 two-tier session row contracts:
- **Leading 16px Cell Arbitration**: Prioritizes warning/runni"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"ng state dots; when idle, unarchived, and non-blank, delegates to `sidebar.session.row.leading` for "},{"id":"p10s9","text":"native automation indicator anchors (e.g. `dsh-schedule` task clock icon);
- **Hover Card Injection*"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"*: Mounts `sidebar.session.row.hover` in `SessionHoverContent` for external task inspection.
- **Smo"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"oth Title Marquee (`useTitleMarquee`)**: Replicates official 0.03px/ms constant-speed crawling with "},{"id":"p10s12","text":"12px double-edge linear gradient fade masks (`[data-scrolled]` & `[data-clipped]`), dynamic ellipsis"},{"id":"p10s13","text":" cut-off (`text-overflow: clip`), and full `prefers-reduced-motion` compliance.
- **AnimatedRows Lay"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"out Contract**: Injects semantic `data-row-key` attributes across sessions and workspaces to seamles"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"sly integrate with official FLIP layout animations.
- **Typography Hierarchy**:
- **Root / Parent Se"},{"id":"p10s16","text":"ssions**: Highlighted with `font-weight: 500` (Medium) and primary text color;
- **Branch Child Sess"},{"id":"p10s17","text":"ions**: Subdued to secondary text color (`var(--dsw-alias-label-secondary)`), brightening dynamicall"},{"id":"p10s18","text":"y on hover/selection;
- **L-shaped Guide Rails**: Native `IconTreeCornerRegular` coupled with zero-D"},{"id":"p10s19","text":"OM CSS background multi-level guide rails (`.deepBranch` for `depth >= 2`)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 2. Sorting Engine & View Controls
- **`placeFork` Native Clustering**: Re-orders forked sessions"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" immediately adjacent to and above their parent session rather than dumping them at arbitrary list e"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"nds.
- **Strict View Order By**: Strictly limits ordering to officially supported modes: `manual` (d"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"rag-and-drop reordering) and `updated` (recency sort).
- **Tri-State Archive Filtering**: Supports `"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"all` (show all), `hide-archived` (default), and `only-archived` (inspect archive history directly in"},{"id":"p11s6","text":" the sidebar).
- **Collapsed Ancestor Pathfinding (`isCurrentCollapsedAncestor`)**: When the active "},{"id":"p11s7","text":"session is hidden beneath a folded branch, ancestor chevrons and badges highlight in business primar"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"y color (`var(--dsw-alias-state-business-primary)`).
- **Panel Activation Dimming (`usePanelInfo`)**"},{"id":"p11s9","text":": Suppresses session selection backgrounds when full-screen settings or file panels are active to pr"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"event dual-focus visual conflict."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### 3. Collapsed Status Bubbling
- **Blindspot Self-Healing**: When a session family with active run"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"s is collapsed, descendant statuses bubble up to the visible root node.
- **Strict Priority State Ma"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"chine**:
1. `Warning` (Highest): Bubble amber dot and replace trailing timestamp with explicit actio"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"n label (e.g., "Waiting Approval", "Plan Review", "Waiting Answer");
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### 5. Engine Reliability & Security
- **Heap-Allocated Explicit Stack Algorithms**: `buildSessionTr"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ee`, `flattenSessionTree`, `findSessionAncestors`, `aggregateDescendantStatus`, `sortTreeByUpdatedAt"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"` all execute via heap-allocated stacks, proven safe against **20,000-level recursion depth**.
- **I"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"n-Place Shadowing & ErrorBoundary**: In-place replacement of `sidebar.workspaces` wrapped in a React"},{"id":"p13s5","text":" `ErrorBoundary`. Crashes fall back to official vanilla renderers without white-screening the app.
-"},{"id":"p13s6","text":" **Native V4 Zstandard Compatibility**: Automatically prioritizes and parses `session.v4.jsonl.zstd`"},{"id":"p13s7","text":", tolerating torn-tail frames.
- **Security & Network Isolation**: Loopback authority verification ("},{"id":"p13s8","text":"`isLoopbackHost`), DNS rebinding defense, and browser `Sec-Fetch` CSRF prevention."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## 🏗 Technical Architecture"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"For detailed topological maps, complexity bounds, sequence diagrams, and formal invariants, see:
